title: Nashville uses eminent domain to block data center near zoo
summary: Nashville city council has approved using eminent domain to halt a data center project that was planned near a local zoo, prioritizing community and environmental concerns over commercial development interests.
problem_solved: Addresses the conflict between data center development and community/environmental preservation interests near residential and zoo areas.
why_valuable: Demonstrates how local governments can use legal tools to balance urban development with community welfare and environmental protection.
